name: Stun Grenade
pickupText: Chance to stun on hit.
description: 5% (+5% per stack) chance on hit to stun enemies for 2 seconds.

stacking.formula: Util.CheckRoll(Util.ConvertAmplificationPercentageIntoReductionPercentage(5f * n * procCoefficient)) (SetStateOnHurt), then SetStun(2f). HYPERBOLIC, not linear: 4.76% at one stack, 9.09% at two, 13.04% at three, 33.3% at ten — approaching but never reaching 100%. Per the schema convention for this type, `base` is the amplification INPUT (5), not the chance a player sees. The proc coefficient is folded INSIDE the amplification, so a half-proc hit gives hyperbolic(2.5n) rather than half of hyperbolic(5n).

stacking.stat: Lockboxes you can open (one spawns per stage)
stacking.formula: SceneDirector counts PLAYERS holding at least one key — `GetItemCountEffective(TreasureCache) > 0` increments a counter once per player — and spawns that many lockboxes. Extra keys therefore do NOT add lockboxes to a stage. Opening one costs a key (CostTypeIndex.TreasureCacheItem transforms it to ItemIndex.None), so N keys buys N openings across a run at one cache per stage.

The Lockbox prefab's own `dropTable` pointer resolves in-bundle to dtLockbox (ror2-base-treasurecache): tier2Weight = 4, tier3Weight = 1, every other weight 0. 4/5 = 80% uncommon, 1/5 = 20% legendary — the description is exact — and tier1Weight 0 means a lockbox can never give a white item.

unlock.requirement: Defeat the Teleporter boss under 15 seconds.

descriptionNote: Stacking does not spawn more caches. Exactly one lockbox spawns per player who holds any Rusted Key, and opening it consumes one key — so a second key is a second opening on a later stage, not a second cache on this one.

name: Wax Quail
pickupText: Jumping while sprinting boosts you forward.
description: Jumping while sprinting boosts you forward by 10m (+10m per stack).

stacking.formula: Derived from code and confirmed by replaying CharacterMotor.PreMove. GenericCharacterMain sets horizontalBonus = (sqrt(10n/a) + moveSpeed/a) / (moveSpeed/a) where a = acceleration x airControl (0.25), so the launch speed is moveSpeed + sqrt(10na) - an excess of sqrt(10na) over the walk target. PreMove bleeds that excess off with Vector3.MoveTowards at exactly a m/s^2, so the extra ground covered is excess^2 / 2a = 5n metres, INDEPENDENT of both moveSpeed and acceleration. The game's '10m' is the 10f constant inside the square root, not a distance. Caveat: the boost needs sqrt(10n/a) seconds to bleed off, and a standard jump is airborne 1.0s (jumpPower 15, gravity -30) - so low-acceleration survivors such as MUL-T (a = 7.5) land before the boost has fully bled off and gain less at high stacks.

unlock.requirement: Reach +300% movespeed (includes sprinting).

descriptionNote: The boost is 5m per stack, not 10m. The 10 in the game's text is a constant inside a square root, not a distance — the launch speed it produces bleeds off under air drag after covering exactly half that. Derivation and a 60Hz replay of the motor loop are in scripts/verify-wax-quail.mjs.

stacking.formula: GlobalEventManager: `LocalCheckRoll(4f * n)` on kill — LINEAR at 4% per stack, not the hyperbolic curve most on-hit chances use — spawning Prefabs/NetworkedObjects/BonusMoneyPack.

The pack's MoneyPickup component carries baseGoldReward = 25 with shouldScale = true, read from the item's OWN bundle (ror2-base-bonusgoldpackonkill) — which is what distinguishes it from the identical 25 on a DLC3 drone pack and from VoidCoinBarrel's goldReward of 25. `shouldScale` routes it through Run.GetDifficultyScaledCost, i.e. 25 x difficultyCoefficient^1.25, which is the description's 'Scales over time'.

descriptionNote: 'Scales over time' is precisely 25 x difficultyCoefficient^1.25 — the same exponent the game uses for chest prices, so the drop keeps pace with what things cost rather than with your damage.

name: Squid Polyp
pickupText: Activating an interactable summons a Squid Turret nearby.
description: Activating an interactable summons a Squid Turret that attacks nearby enemies at 100% (+100% per stack) attack speed. Lasts 30 seconds.

stacking.formula: The turret is given 10 * (n - 1) BoostAttackSpeed items (GlobalEventManager), each worth +10% attack speed (CharacterBody: attackSpeed += count * 0.1f) — exactly +100% per stack over the turret's own 100%.

unlock.requirement: Activate 6 turrets in a single run.

name: Death Mark
pickupText: Enemies with 4 or more debuffs are marked for death, taking bonus damage.
description: Enemies with 4 or more debuffs are marked for death, increasing damage taken by 50% from all sources for 7 (+7 per stack) seconds.

stacking.formula: AddTimedBuff(Buffs.DeathMark, 7f * n) (GlobalEventManager). Linear. The 4-debuff threshold is a literal `if (num >= 4)` counted over BuffCatalog.debuffBuffIndices, and the mark cannot refresh while already applied.

name: Shuriken
pickupText: Activating your Primary skill also throws a shuriken. Recharges over time.
description: Activating your Primary skill also throws a shuriken that deals 400% (+100% per stack) base damage. You can hold up to 3 (+1 per stack) shurikens which all reload over 10 seconds.

stacking.formula: FireProjectileWithoutDamageType(ShurikenProjectile, …, body.damage * (3f + 1f * stack)) (PrimarySkillShurikenBehavior) — 400% at one stack, +100% per stack.
`int num = stack + 2` (PrimarySkillShurikenBehavior), reloading over totalReloadTime = 10f. 3 at one stack, +1 per stack.

name: Shipping Request Form
pickupText: Get a delivery each stage that contains powerful items.
description: A delivery containing 2 items (79%/20%/1%) will appear in a random location on each stage. Increases rarity chances of the items per stack.

stacking.stat: Red-item weight multiplier on the delivery
stacking.formula: FreeChestDropTable.RebuildSelection weights the three drop lists as 0.79, 0.20 x n and 0.01 x n^2, with n summed across ALL PLAYERS. White does not scale, green scales linearly and red scales QUADRATICALLY, so the split runs 79/20/1 at one stack, 64.2/32.5/3.3 at two and 53.4/40.5/6.1 at three. The row's own numbers are the n in that n^2 term; the split itself is the useful figure and is given here because no single per-stack number can express a quadratic.

name: Unstable Transmitter
pickupText: Gain a temporary barrier and a dimensional aura on low health.
description: Falling below 25% health gives you 60% of your maximum health as a temporary barrier and a dimensional aura for 8s that bleeds and teleports away enemies. Enemies killed by the aura extend the duration by 1s. Regenerates at the start of each stage.

stacking.formula: RefreshCooldown: cooldown = 1.1f x (1 - Util.Hyperbolic((n - 1) x 0.1f)), where Hyperbolic(x) = 1 - 1/(1+x). So 1.1s at one stack, 1.0s at two, 0.917s at three — approaching but never reaching 0. This is the anti-retrigger window, separate from the once-per-stage charge, and is the ONLY thing extra stacks do: the 25% threshold, the 60% barrier and the 8s aura are all hardcoded literals with no stack term.

name: Item Scrap, Green
pickupText: Does nothing. Prioritized when used with 3D Printers.
description: An Uncommon-rarity scrap with no effect. Consumed first by 3D Printers and Cauldrons, letting you preserve real items.

name: Sale Star
pickupText: First chest bought yields more than one reward. Usable once per stage.
description: Gain an extra item on the first chest opened per stage. Each additional Sale Star increases the chance of getting more items by 5%.

stacking.stat: Items from the first compatible purchase
stacking.formula: PurchaseInteraction sets `dropCount = 2 + num2` (on ChestBehavior or RouletteChestController) after transforming your Sale Stars into LowerPricedChestsConsumed. The transformation runs minToTransform 1 / maxToTransform int.MaxValue, so the ENTIRE stack is spent on that one purchase. At one Sale Star num2 is hardcoded to 0, i.e. exactly one extra item.

With two or more Sale Stars a cascade runs for i = 1,2,3 at thresholds 30%, 15% and 1%, each roll gated on the previous one succeeding, and num2 becomes the highest i that passed. From THREE stars up, every threshold gains `(1 - 1/(n x 0.05 + 1)) x 100` — the game's usual hyperbolic curve on a 5%-per-stack amplification — so at 3 stars the thresholds are 43.0/28.0/14.0, at 5 they are 50.0/35.0/21.0, and at 10 they are 63.3/48.3/34.3.

descriptionNote: Two things the text does not say. Every Sale Star you hold is consumed by the first compatible purchase, not one per stage per star. And the '5%' is hyperbolic and only applies from THREE stars up — the second star is the big one, taking the chance of a third item from 0% to 30%, while the third adds about 13 points on top.

name: Hunter's Harpoon
pickupText: Killing an enemy gives you a burst of movement speed.
description: Killing an enemy increases movement speed by 125%, fading over 1 (+0.5 per stack) seconds.

stacking.formula: duration = 1f + (n - 1) * 0.5f (GlobalEventManager), applied as a series of KillMoveSpeed buffs so the speed fades rather than dropping off.

name: Ignition Tank
pickupText: Your ignite effects deal quadruple damage.
description: Ignite effects deal +300% (+300% per stack) more damage over time.

stacking.formula: multiplier = 1 + 3 * n on both damageMultiplier and totalDamage (StrengthenBurnUtils). Linear. Two things the description omits: the Oiled debuff (DLC2) counts as one extra stack, and it triggers the upgrade even at ZERO Ignition Tanks.

name: Regenerating Scrap
pickupText: Prioritized when used with Uncommon 3D Printers. Usable once per stage.
description: Does nothing. Prioritized when used with Uncommon 3D Printers. At the start of each stage, it regenerates.

name: Breaching Fin
pickupText: Grounded enemies hit with any skill are launched and take bonus damage.
description: Grounded enemies hit with any skill are launched and stunned. Enemies hit while airborne are launched again up to 2 times (+1 per stack). Launched enemies take 10% increased damage from all sources per launch. Recharges after 15s.

stacking.formula: SetBuffCount(KnockUpHitEnemies, 2 + (n - 1)) (HealthComponent). Linear.

name: Chance Doll
pickupText: Gain 40% chance to increase item rarity at Shrines of Chance.
description: 40% (+10% per stack) chance to get higher rarity items from Shrines of Chance on success.

stacking.stat: Higher-rarity chance at Shrine of Chance (%)
stacking.formula: Util.CheckRoll(30 + n * 10) (ShrineChanceBehavior). 40% at one stack, +10% per stack - the increment applies from the first stack, and here the description's 40% base already accounts for it.

name: Luminous Shot
pickupText: Activating your Secondary skill charges your Primary skill with powerful lightning strikes. Requires 3 charges.
description: Activating your Secondary skill stores up to 5 charges (+1 per stack). At 3 charges, your Primary skill fires lightning strikes dealing 175% (+50% per stack) TOTAL damage each. Reduces Secondary skill cooldown by 20%.

stacking.formula: AddIncreasePrimaryDamageStack: cap = 4 + n, buff only added while buffCount < cap (CharacterBody). 5 at one stack, +1 per stack.
baseDamage = damageInfo.damage * (1.75f + (n - 1) * 0.5f) (GlobalEventManager). Linear.

name: Noxious Thorn
pickupText: Killing an enemy transfers debuffs to a nearby enemy.
description: Gain 10% chance to bleed an enemy. On killing an enemy, transfer 33% of every debuff stack to 1 enemy (+1 per stack) within 20m (+5m per stack).

stacking.formula: targets = n, decremented once per vine chain created (CharacterBody). Linear.
sphereSearch.radius = 20f + 5f * (n - 1) (CharacterBody). Linear.

name: Prayer Beads
pickupText: Gains experience alongside you. Upon removal, grants bonus stats.
description: Grows by gaining experience, storing 20% (+5% per stack) bonus stats (health, regeneration, and damage). On removal, gain all stored stats.

stacking.formula: CalculateAppliedBeadStats: targetStat += beadLevels * levelStat * (0.2f + 0.05f * (n - 1)) (CharacterBody). 20% of the per-level stat at one stack, +5% per stack. Applied to FOUR stats - levelMaxHealth, levelMaxShield, levelRegen and levelDamage - so it also grants shield, which the description omits.

name: Box of Dynamite
pickupText: Your drones periodically drop dynamite.
description: Gain Lt. Droneboy. While in combat, your drones drop sticks of dynamite that detonate for 240% (+85% per stack) damage, stunning enemies. Recharges after 10 seconds.

stacking.formula: DroneDynamiteBehaviour: `damage = base.body.damage * (2.4f + 0.85f * (stack - 1))`, i.e. 240% + 85% per extra stack, exactly as stated. The subtlety is `base.body`: this behaviour is attached by DroneDynamiteDisplay, an item held by the DRONE, so the coefficient applies to the drone's damage stat and not to yours.

`rechargeTimer += 10f` after each throw (baseCooldown = 10f). It does not scale with stacks — extra copies buy damage, never rate. Enemy checks run every 0.25s while the timer is down, so a stick goes out within a quarter-second of an enemy being in range.

searchDistance = 30f with searchRadius = 2.5f, checked on a 0.25s searchInterval. The drone must find something within 30m before it throws — the description's 'while in combat' is this check, not a combat-state flag.
blastRadius = 7 on the DynamiteProjectile prefab (ror2-dlc3 items bundle for DronesDropDynamite), thrown with force = 500 in a random direction (Random.onUnitSphere).

descriptionNote: The 240% is of the DRONE's damage, not yours — the behaviour runs on the drone, via an item the drone holds. And 'while in combat' is literally an enemy within 30m, checked four times a second; the 10s recharge never scales with stacks.

name: Collector's Compulsion
pickupText: Pickups grant a stacking bonus to all stats. Open a barrel to find a minor pick-up.
description: Picking up an item or other collectible increases all stats by +3% for 20 seconds, up to 3 (+2 per stack) times. Barrels grant minor pickups.

stacking.formula: return 3 + 2 * (n - 1) (CharacterBody). Linear.

name: Faraday Spur
pickupText: Moving around builds up movement speed and jump height. At 25% charge or higher, jump to discharge into an electric blast.
description: Moving builds charge, granting up to +160% movement speed and +200% jump height at 100%. At 25% charge or higher, jumping triggers an explosive discharge for 400% (+280% per stack) damage in a 5m to 32.3m (+7.5m per stack) area.

stacking.formula: discharge damage = 4 + 2.8(n-1) as a base-damage coefficient (JumpDamageStrikeBodyBehavior: 4f + 2.8f * (stack - 1)). Linear: 400%, 680%, 960%.

radius = 0.2 x (charge - 1) + 5 + 7.5n (GetRadius). At the 100 charge limit that is 19.8 + 5 + 7.5n, i.e. 32.3m at 1 stack, 39.8m at 2. Note the (charge - 1): the max is 19.8, not 20. Radius is 0 below 25 charge.

name: Kinetic Dampener
pickupText: Gain bonus armor while you have a shield. When shield breaks, release a stunning pulse that deals more damage the more shield you have.
description: Increases armor by 30 (+30 per stack) while you have a shield. When shield breaks, release a stunning pulse for 100% damage plus 100% (+10% per stack) of your max shield. Grants a shield for 4% of your max health.

stacking.formula: armor += 30n while healthComponent.shield > 0 (RecalculateStats, guarded by `if (shield > 0f && n > 0)`). Linear.

HealthComponent.GetShieldBoosterDamage: baseDamage = body.damage + body.maxShield * (1f + 0.1f * (n - 1)) — 100% base damage plus 100% of max shield at one stack, +10% of max shield per stack. The blast is 12.5m radius with procCoefficient 1 and 500 force, none of which the description mentions.

shield += 0.04 x maxHealth if you hold ANY Kinetic Dampener (RecalculateStats: (n > 0) ? 0.04f * maxHealth : 0f). Flat - it does NOT scale with stacks. Stated in the in-game description but absent from this dataset until now.

name: Brilliant Behemoth
pickupText: All your attacks explode!
description: All your attacks explode in a 4m (+1.5m per stack) radius for a bonus 60% TOTAL damage to nearby enemies.

stacking.formula: blast radius = (1.5 + 2.5n) x procCoefficient metres (GlobalEventManager). Code-verified at proc 1.0: 4m at 1, 6.5m at 2, 9m at 3, 11.5m at 4. Two things the in-game description omits: it says +1.5m per stack but the code adds 2.5m, and the radius is multiplied by the triggering attack’s proc coefficient, so a 0.5-proc hit explodes at half size.

descriptionNote: The radius grows 2.5m per stack, not 1.5m, and the explosion's damage scales with the triggering hit's proc coefficient — a detail the text omits entirely.

name: Ceremonial Dagger
pickupText: Killing an enemy releases homing daggers.
description: Killing an enemy fires out 3 homing daggers that deal 150% (+150% per stack) base damage.

stacking.formula: dagger damageCoefficient = 1.5f x n (GlobalEventManager). Linear: 150% base per stack.

name: Alien Head
pickupText: Reduces cooldowns for your skills.
description: Reduce skill cooldowns by 25% (+25% per stack).

stacking.formula: cooldown multiplied by 0.75 per stack (multiplicative, so reduction never reaches 100%)

name: 57 Leaf Clover
pickupText: Luck is on your side.
description: All random effects are rolled +1 (+1 per stack) times for a favorable outcome.

stacking.formula: +1 luck per stack (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats: luck += Clover count). Luck L = (57 Leaf Clover stacks - Purity stacks). Util.CheckRoll rolls 1 + ceil(|L|) times and keeps the BEST result when L > 0, the WORST when L < 0. Effective chance = 1 - (1-p)^(1+L) for positive luck: a 10% proc becomes 19.0% at L=1 and 27.1% at L=2.

unlock.requirement: Complete 20 stages in a single run.

name: Dio's Best Friend
pickupText: Cheat death. Consumed on use.
description: Upon death, this item will be consumed and you will return to life with 3 seconds of invulnerability.

stacking.formula: CharacterMaster consumes exactly one stack per death — an ItemTransformation of ExtraLife into ExtraLifeConsumed — so one extra life per stack. RespawnExtraLife then does `AddTimedBuff(RoR2Content.Buffs.Immune, 3f)`, confirming the 3 seconds. Undocumented: the respawn is at your death position, but if you were killed by an unsafe area the game first searches for a safe destination rather than dropping you back into it.

unlock.requirement: Stay alive for 30 consecutive minutes.

descriptionNote: The in-game text does not say what stacking does. Each copy is consumed separately — one death, one stack — so N of them is N extra lives, and the 3-second invulnerability applies to every revive rather than only the first.

name: Sentient Meat Hook
pickupText: Chance to hook all nearby enemies.
description: 20% (+20% per stack) chance on hit to fire homing hooks at up to 10 (+5 per stack) enemies for 100% TOTAL damage.

stacking.formula: chance = (1 - 100/(100 + 20n)) x 100 (GlobalEventManager). Hyperbolic: 16.7% at 1 stack, 28.6% at 2, 37.5% at 3 - approaches but never reaches 100%.
maxTargets = 5 + 5n (GlobalEventManager). Linear: 10 enemies at 1 stack, 15 at 2, 20 at 3.

unlock.requirement: Loop back to the first stage.

name: Happiest Mask
pickupText: Chance on killing an enemy to summon a ghost.
description: Killing enemies has a 7% chance to spawn a ghost of the killed enemy with 1500% damage. Lasts 30s (+30s per stack).

stacking.formula: Util.TryToCreateGhost(victim, attacker, n * 30) (GlobalEventManager). Linear.

name: Frost Relic
pickupText: Killing enemies surrounds you with an ice storm.
description: Killing an enemy surrounds you with an ice storm that deals 1200% damage per second and slows enemies by 80% for 1.5s. Each kill grows the radius by 2m, up to 18m (+12m per stack).

stacking.formula: maxIcicleCount = baseIcicleMax + (n - 1) * icicleMaxPerStack = 6 + 3(n-1) (IcicleAuraController). The live count is min(2 + kills, maxIcicleCount), so 2 icicles appear on the first kill.

radius = characterBody.radius + icicleBaseRadius (10f) + icicleRadiusPerIcicle (2f) x icicles (IcicleAuraController.UpdateRadius). At the 6-icicle cap that is 22m PLUS the survivor's own collider radius, and +6m per stack (3 more icicles x 2m). The listed number excludes the collider term because it is read from each body's CapsuleCollider and so differs per survivor.

descriptionNote: The storm caps at 22m plus your own collider radius and grows 6m per stack, not 18m and 12m. The 2m-per-kill growth is right; the cap is six icicles (+3 per stack) at 2m each on top of a 10m base.

name: H3AD-5T v2
pickupText: Increase jump height. Hold 'Interact' to slam down to the ground.
description: Increase jump height. Creates a 5m-100m radius kinetic explosion on hitting the ground, dealing 1000%-10000% base damage that scales with fall distance. Recharges in 10 (-50% per stack) seconds.

stacking.formula: duration /= n (HeadstompersCooldown.OnEnter, baseDuration 10s). Reciprocal: 10s, 5s, 3.3s, 2.5s.

name: N'kuhana's Opinion
pickupText: Fire haunting skulls when healed.
description: Store 100% (+100% per stack) of healing as Soul Energy. When your Soul Energy reaches 10% of your maximum health, fire a skull that deals 250% of your Soul Energy as damage.

stacking.formula: devilOrbHealPool = Mathf.Min(devilOrbHealPool + healAmount * n, fullCombinedHealth) (HealthComponent.Heal). Linear, +100% per stack, and the pool is hard-capped at your combined health+shield.

unlock.requirement: Find the Altar to N'kuhana.

name: Unstable Tesla Coil
pickupText: Shock all nearby enemies every 10 seconds.
description: Fire out lightning that hits 3 (+2 per stack) enemies for 200% base damage every 0.5s. The Tesla Coil switches off every 10 seconds.

stacking.formula: LightningOrb with bouncesRemaining = 2 * stack, so 1 + 2n targets — 3 at one stack, +2 per stack. Damage is body.damage * 2f (200%). Two things the description omits: the orb carries a procCoefficient of only 0.3, and it fires on a 1/12s interval with the target list clearing every 0.5s rather than a flat 'every 0.5s'.

unlock.requirement: Deal 5000 damage in one shot.

name: Soulbound Catalyst
pickupText: Kills reduce equipment cooldown.
description: Kills reduce equipment cooldown by 4s (+2s per stack).

stacking.formula: DeductActiveEquipmentCooldown(2f + n * 2f) (GlobalEventManager). 4s at one stack, +2s per stack.

unlock.requirement: Discover and activate 8 unique Newt Altars.

name: Hardlight Afterburner
pickupText: Add 2 extra charges of your Utility skill. Reduce Utility skill cooldown.
description: Add +2 (+2 per stack) charges of your Utility skill. Reduces Utility skill cooldown by 33%.

stacking.formula: utilityBonusStockSkill.SetBonusStockFromBody(n * 2) (CharacterBody). Linear, +2 charges per stack.

name: Wake of Vultures
pickupText: Temporarily steal the power of slain elites.
description: Gain the power of any killed elite monster for 8s (+5s per stack).

stacking.formula: duration = 3f + 5f * n (GlobalEventManager). 8s at one stack, +5s per stack.

name: Brainstalks
pickupText: Skills have NO cooldowns for a short period after killing an elite.
description: Upon killing an elite monster, enter a frenzy for 4s (+4s per stack) where skills have no cooldowns.

stacking.formula: frenzy duration = 4n seconds (GlobalEventManager: AddTimedBuff(NoCooldowns, count * 4f)). Linear. The frenzy itself sets cooldownScale to exactly 0 (`if (HasBuff(NoCooldowns)) num113 = 0f;`), i.e. NO cooldown — not a reduced one. The only exception is skills flagged `limitCooldown`, which clamp to their own `minCooldownCoefficient` rather than reaching zero.

unlock.requirement: Defeat an Elite boss on Monsoon difficulty.

name: Rejuvenation Rack
pickupText: Double the strength of healing.
description: Heal +100% (+100% per stack) more.

stacking.formula: amount *= 1f + n (HealthComponent.Heal). Linear, +100% per stack.

unlock.requirement: Without healing, reach and complete the 3rd Teleporter event.

name: Aegis
pickupText: Healing past full grants you a temporary barrier.
description: Healing past full grants you a temporary barrier for 50% (+50% per stack) of the amount you healed.

stacking.formula: barrier = overheal x (n * 0.5f) (HealthComponent). Linear, +50% per stack.

name: Shattering Justice
pickupText: Reduce the armor of enemies after repeatedly striking them.
description: After hitting an enemy 5 times, reduce their armor by 60 for 8 (+8 per stack) seconds.

stacking.formula: AddTimedBuff(Buffs.Pulverized, 8f * n) (HealthComponent). Linear. The -60 armor is the fixed Pulverized buff and does not scale.

name: Resonance Disc
pickupText: Obtain a Resonance Disc charged by killing enemies. Fires automatically when fully charged.
description: Killing 4 enemies in 7 seconds charges the Resonance Disc. It launches toward a target for 300% (+300% per stack) base damage, piercing enemies, then explodes for 1000% (+1000% per stack) base damage, and returns to you striking enemies for 300% (+300% per stack) base damage.

stacking.formula: LaserTurbineBaseState.GetDamage returns ownerBody.damage * n, and FireMainBeamState applies secondBombDamageCoefficient = 10.0 (EntityStateConfiguration asset) - 1000% at one stack, linear in stacks.

Same GetDamage() x mainBeamDamageCoefficient = 3.0 (asset) - 300%, linear. The charge condition is confirmed by the same asset: killChargesRequired = 4 within killChargeDuration = 7s. Beam proc coefficient is 1.0.

name: Defensive Microbots
pickupText: Shoot down nearby projectiles. Recharge rate scales with attack speed.
description: Shoot down 1 (+1 per stack) projectiles within 20m every 0.5 seconds. Recharge rate scales with attack speed.

stacking.formula: DefenseMatrixOn.DeleteNearbyProjectile walks the live ProjectileController list and stops at `num2 >= itemStack`, so the stack count is literally the number destroyed per volley. Projectiles marked cannotBeDeleted are skipped, and only ones on another team count.
projectileEraserRadius = 20 (EntityStateConfiguration), compared squared against the attached body's core position.

stacking.stat: Volleys per second at 1.0 attack speed
stacking.formula: `rechargeFrequency = baseRechargeFrequency * attachedBody.attackSpeed` with baseRechargeFrequency = 2 — so two volleys a second at base attack speed, i.e. the 0.5s the description states, and it scales with attack speed exactly as claimed. Separately, `fireFrequency = Max(minimumFireFrequency, rechargeFrequency)` with minimumFireFrequency = 10 means it LOOKS for projectiles at least ten times a second regardless — the recharge gates the shot, not the search, so a projectile entering range is caught within a tenth of a second once a charge is up.

stacking.stat: Granted free to Captain and his drones
stacking.formula: CaptainDefenseMatrixController on CaptainBody: defenseMatrixToGrantPlayer = 1 and defenseMatrixToGrantMechanicalAllies = 1 — Captain starts with one, and each of his mechanical allies gets one too, on top of any copies you pick up.

descriptionNote: The 0.5 seconds is a recharge, not a scan interval: the microbots check for projectiles at least 10 times a second and fire the moment a charge is available, so entering range does not cost you half a second of exposure.

name: Laser Scope
pickupText: Your 'Critical Strikes' deal an additional 100% damage.
description: Critical Strikes deal an additional 100% damage (+100% per stack).

stacking.formula: critMultiplier = 2f + 1f * n (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats) - the base multiplier is 2x, so each stack adds another +100% of base damage on a crit.

name: Pocket I.C.B.M.
pickupText: All Missile items deal more damage and fire an additional two missiles.
description: All missile items and equipment fire an additional 2 missiles. Increase missile damage by 0% (+50% per stack).

stacking.formula: MissileUtils.GetMoreMissileDamageMultiplier: Mathf.Max(1f, 1f + 0.5f * (n - 1)). The first stack gives NO damage bonus - it is +50% per stack beyond the first, exactly as the description's unusual '0%' base says. The extra missiles are separate: the fire count becomes `(n <= 0) ? 1 : 3`, i.e. +2, and does not scale further with stacks.

name: Spare Drone Parts
pickupText: Your drones fire faster, have less cooldowns, shoot missiles, and gain a bonus chaingun.
description: Gain Col. Droneman. Drones gain +25% (+25% per stack) attack speed and cooldown reduction. Drones gain a 10% chance to fire a missile on hit for 150% TOTAL damage, and an automatic chain gun dealing 6x50% damage bouncing to 2 enemies.

stacking.formula: Grants n DroneWeaponsBoost to your drones; each adds attackSpeedPerStack = 0.25 (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats). Linear +25% per stack.
cooldown x= 0.75 per stack, applied in a per-stack loop (DroneWeaponsBoostBehavior.cooldownReductionPerStack = 0.75). Exponential: x0.75, x0.5625, x0.4219.

name: Interstellar Desk Plant
pickupText: Plant a healing fruit on kill.
description: On kill, plant a healing fruit seed that grows into a plant after 5 seconds. The plant heals for 5% of maximum health every 0.5 second to all allies within 10m (+5m per stack). Lasts 10 seconds.

stacking.formula: HealingWard.Networkradius = healingRadius + radiusIncreasePerStack * n, with both serialized as 5.0 on the InterstellarDeskPlant prefab — 10m at one stack, +5m per stack.

descriptionNote: The in-game text is wrong in three places, and the numbers above are the verified ones. It heals 5% every 0.5s (DeskplantWard: healFraction 0.05, interval 0.5), not 10% every second — the same rate, but it matters for a plant that only lives 10s. And the radius is 10m at one stack, not 5m: the controller computes healingRadius (5) + 5 x stacks, so the first stack already adds its 5m.

name: Symbiotic Scorpion
pickupText: Permanently reduce armor on hit.
description: 100% chance on hit to reduce armor by 2 (+2 per stack) permanently.

stacking.formula: Each hit runs `for (j = 0; j < n; j++)` applying one PermanentDebuff stack per roll, and RecalculateStats does `armor -= buffCount * 2f` — so 2 armor per stack, permanently. The roll is `100f * procCoefficient`, so despite the description's '100% chance' a low-proc hit can apply fewer than n stacks.

name: Ben's Raincoat
pickupText: Prevent debuffs, instead gaining a temporary barrier. Recharges over time.
description: Prevents 1 (+1 per stack) debuff and instead grants a temporary barrier for 10% of your COMBINED health and shield. Recharges every 5 seconds.

stacking.formula: ImmuneToDebuffBehavior.OverrideDebuff loops `for (i = 0; i < stack; i++)`, so one debuff per stack, then applies a 5s ImmuneToDebuffCooldown (cooldownSeconds = 5f).

descriptionNote: The barrier is 10% of `fullCombinedHealth` (ImmuneToDebuffBehavior), not 10% of maximum health — so on a shielded build such as Transcendence or Silence Between Two Strikes it is materially larger than the in-game wording implies.

name: Bottled Chaos
pickupText: Activating your Equipment triggers an additional, random Equipment effect.
description: Trigger a random equipment effect 1 (+1 per stack) time(s).

stacking.formula: EquipmentSlot: `for (i = 0; i < n; i++)` firing one random equipment effect per iteration. Linear.

name: Electric Boomerang
pickupText: On hit chance to throw a stunning boomerang.
description: 15% chance on hit to fire an electric boomerang that slices through enemies dealing 120% base damage and deals an additional 120% (+120% per stack) base damage per second and stuns all enemies hit. Can strike enemies on the way back.

stacking.formula: GlobalEventManager: `LocalCheckRoll(15f * damageInfo.procCoefficient)` — a flat 15 with NO stack term, so extra copies buy damage and never frequency. It is linear in the proc coefficient rather than hyperbolic, so a half-proc hit is a straight 7.5%. Two hard gates the text omits: the roll is skipped entirely if the hit already carries ProcType.StunAndPierceDamage (so a boomerang cannot spawn another), and if the damage type includes DamageTypeExtended.Electrocution.

The projectile is fired with `characterBody.damage * 0.4f * n` and the StunAndPierceBoomerang prefab carries damageCoefficient = 3.1, so the product is 1.24 x n — i.e. 124% per stack, against the 120% the game's text states for both of its damage numbers. NOT resolved: a 4% gap is small enough to be a rounding convention in the description and large enough not to be assumed, and we cannot yet tell which of the two stated 120% figures the 3.1 component produces. Left as the game states it rather than corrected on a product we cannot attribute.

The game's own text states 120% (+120% per stack) base damage per second; our 42% appeared in no game file at all. NOT yet code-verified: the projectile is fired with `characterBody.damage * 0.4f * n` (GlobalEventManager) into StunAndPierceBoomerang, whose overlap component carries damageCoefficient 3.1 at fireFrequency 60 with resetFrequency 10 — reconciling those into a per-second figure is an open question (MATH-VERIFICATION 3j.32).

descriptionNote: The 15% chance does NOT scale with stacks — extra copies raise the boomerang's damage only. It also scales linearly with the hit's proc coefficient, and cannot be triggered by Electrocution damage or by another boomerang. Separately, the boomerang suppresses Tri-Tip Dagger's bleed: GlobalEventManager skips its BleedOnHit proc when the projectile is flagged isStunAndPierce, so the two items anti-synergise in a way neither description mentions.

name: Growth Nectar
pickupText: Your buffs grant an increase to ALL of your stats.
description: Grants a 4% increase to ALL stats for each buff you have, up to a maximum of 4 (+4 per stack) buffs.

name: Runic Lens
pickupText: Chance to call down a meteor. Damage and chance are increased with higher damage hits.
description: 3% chance on hit to call down a meteor for 2000% base damage. Every 100% attack damage dealt increases the activation chance by 3% (+3% per stack) and damage by 150% (+50% per stack).

stacking.formula: chance = 3f + overspill * (3f + 3f * (n - 1)), where overspill = (int)(hitDamage / bodyDamage) (GlobalEventManager). UNDOCUMENTED: the result is hard-capped at 75% (meteorChanceThreshold), and the whole roll is multiplied by the hit's proc coefficient.

MeteorAttackOnHighDamageBodyBehavior.CalculateDamage: multiplier = 20f + overspill * (1.5f + 0.5f * (n - 1)), i.e. a 2000% base meteor plus 150% (+50% per stack) per 100% of overspill damage. UNDOCUMENTED: the multiplier is hard-capped at 75f, so the meteor can never exceed 7500% base damage. The blast has radius 10m and procCoefficient 0.5.

name: Sonorous Whispers
pickupText: Upon large or elite monster kill chance to drop items.
description: When a large monster is killed it always drops an item. All elites have a 4% (+1% per stack) chance to drop an item.

stacking.formula: LocalCheckRoll(4f + 1f * n) (GlobalEventManager), inside a `count > 0` guard. The increment applies from the FIRST stack, so the real chance is 5% at one stack, 6% at two, 7% at three. The in-game description's '4% (+1% per stack)' states the constant rather than the value you actually get - the same defect seen in Bandolier, Ukulele and Safer Spaces. Large monsters are a separate, unconditional 100% roll.

descriptionNote: The elite drop chance is 5% at one stack, not 4%. The code rolls 4 + 1 x stacks, so the first stack already adds its 1%.

name: War Bonds

description: During boss events, 5 missiles bombard the area, dealing 2.5% (+2.5% per stack) of the boss's max health in damage. Before the boss event, gain additional missiles per 50 gold gained, up to a maximum of 20 (+5 per stack).

stacking.stat: Missile damage (% of boss max HP)
stacking.formula: (targetBody.maxHealth + targetBody.maxShield) * (stack * 0.025f) (BarrageOnBossBehaviour) — 2.5% per stack, and measured against max health PLUS SHIELD, not health alone.

maxBuffCount = 15 + stack * 5, so 20 at one stack and +5 per stack. Each extra missile costs Run.GetDifficultyScaledCost(50) gold, so the 50-gold threshold RISES as the run's difficulty coefficient climbs.

descriptionNote: Two things the in-game text leaves out. Against anything that is not a boss the missiles do not use a health percentage at all — they deal `body.damage * 32f`, i.e. 3200% of your damage. And the gold needed per extra missile is difficulty-scaled, so late-run missiles cost far more than 50.

description: Infect up to 4 (+2 per stack) enemies with a computer virus that duplicates 45% of all damage they take into a global pool. Every 3 seconds, all infected enemies suffer 100% of the pooled damage.

name: Orphaned Core
pickupText: Gain a buddy who launches itself at enemies to deal damage. Inherits your movement-related items.
description: Gain a friendly Solus unit that launches itself at enemies for 400% (+400% per stack) damage. It inherits your movement speed items and hits harder the faster it moves, and can be pet to cleanse negative effects. Recharges after 15 seconds.

stacking.formula: EntityStates.FriendUnit.KineticAura: chargeDamageCoefficient = 4 -> 400%, applied as `attack.damage = chargeDamageCoefficient * damageStat`. The per-stack scaling is NOT in that coefficient: PhysicsProjectileBehavior.UpdateMinionInventory keeps the unit stocked with `(newStack - 1) * 10` BoostDamage items, and BoostDamage is +10% each — so two stacks double the unit's damage stat and three triple it, which reproduces +400% per stack exactly.

`GetDamageBoostFromSpeed() = Mathf.Max(1f, moveSpeed / baseMoveSpeed)` multiplies the launch damage — the 'hits harder the faster it moves' clause, floored at 1 so it can never reduce damage. InheritMovementItems copies your movement items onto the unit, which is what makes that ratio climb.
lockonDistance = 30 with lockonAngle = 180, chargeBeforeLaunch = 0.5s and refreshTime = 1.5s between launches (EntityStateConfiguration for KineticAura).
knockbackDamageCoefficient = 10 with knockbackForce = 8000, used instead of the launch hit when the target's mass is at or above massThresholdForKnockback = 250.
EntityStates.FriendUnit.FriendUnitLovesYou: curseStacksToRemove = 5 within cleanseRadius = 15, over baseDuration = 5s.

descriptionNote: The '+400% per stack' is not a bigger coefficient — the unit is handed (stacks - 1) x 10 BoostDamage items, so extra copies raise its damage STAT and the flat 400% coefficient rides on top. That also means anything else buffing the unit's damage compounds with it.

name: Substandard Duplicator
pickupText: Picking up an item grants a temporary copy.
description: Picking up an item gives you a temporary copy of itself. Temporary items last an additional 10 (+10 per stack) seconds.

stacking.formula: DuplicatorBehavior.CalculateNewItemDecayDuration: inventory.SetItemDecayDurationServer(80f + stack * 10). The +10 per stack the description states is exact, but it sits on an 80s base that the item itself installs — so a temporary copy actually lasts 90 seconds at one stack, 100 at two. "An additional 10 seconds" is additional to a baseline the game never shows.

descriptionNote: The stated "+10 per stack" is correct but incomplete: the item sets the temporary-item lifetime to 80 + 10 x stacks seconds, so a copy lasts 90s at one stack rather than 10s. The 80s floor is installed by this item and appears nowhere in its text.

pickupText: Recruit a Beetle Guard.

pickupText: Critical strikes always bleed enemies. Bleeding enemies now explode.
description: Gain 5% critical chance. Critical Strikes bleed enemies for 240% base damage. Bleeding enemies explode on death for 400% (+400% per stack) damage, plus an additional 15% (+15% per stack) of their maximum health.

stacking.formula: damageCoefficient = 4f * (1 + (n - 1)) (GlobalEventManager) - algebraically 4n. Linear.

stacking.stat: Explosion bonus (% of enemy max HP)
stacking.formula: 0.15f * (1 + (n - 1)) of victimBody.maxHealth, added to the base damage (GlobalEventManager). Linear.

name: Halcyon Seed
pickupText: Summon Aurelionite during the Teleporter event.
description: Summon Aurelionite during the teleporter event. It has 100% (+50% per stack) damage and 100% (+100% per stack) health.

stacking.formula: damage multiplier = sqrt(n), NOT +50% per stack. GoldTitanManager does `currentBoostDamageCoefficient *= Mathf.Pow(totalItemCount, 0.5f)` and then grants `RoundToInt((coefficient - 1) * 10)` BoostDamage items at +10% each, so the integer rounding makes it stepped: 100% at 1 seed, 140% at 2, 170% at 3, 200% at 4, 220% at 5. The description's '+50% per stack' matches only the first stack and overstates every one after it — 250% vs the real 200% at four seeds.
health multiplier = n exactly: `currentBoostHpCoefficient *= Mathf.Pow(totalItemCount, 1f)` then `RoundToInt((n - 1) * 10)` BoostHp at +10% each. Linear, and the description is right.

CalcTitanPowerAndBestTeam sums GetItemCountForTeam across every team into `totalItemCount`, so Aurelionite's power comes from ALL players' seeds combined, not just the summoner's — while the team it fights for is whichever single team holds the most.

descriptionNote: The health scaling is exactly as stated, but the damage is sqrt(stacks), not +50% each: 140% at two seeds and 200% at four, where the text implies 150% and 250%. The two curves also draw on ALL players' seeds pooled together, not only yours.

The prefab (SiphonNearbyBodyAttachment) carries radius 13.0, damagePerSecondCoefficient 1.0 and tickRate 4.0 — so 100% of your damage per second, applied in four ticks. Target searching is gated on !outOfCombat, which is the "while in combat" clause.

name: Defense Nucleus
pickupText: Summon an Alpha Construct on killing an elite.
description: Killing elite monsters spawns an Alpha Construct with bonus 300% damage and 300% health. Limited to 4 (+4 per stack).

stacking.formula: CharacterMaster.GetDeployableSameSlotLimit: `result = n * 4` for DeployableSlot.MinorConstructOnKill — 4 per stack. GlobalEventManager gates the spawn on `victimBody.isElite` and on the deployable limit, firing CommonAssets.minorConstructOnKillProjectile at a random heading.

The spawn card cscMinorConstructOnKill carries itemsToGrant = two entries of count 30. BoostHp is `num80 += n * 0.1f` and BoostDamage is `num103 += n * 0.1f` — +10% each — so 30 of each is exactly the stated +300% health and +300% damage, and this is the same mechanism EliteOnlyArtifactManager uses when it grants `(coefficient - 1) * 10` of the pair. Read: both counts (30, 30). Inferred: the two ItemDef pointers are cross-bundle (m_FileID != 0) and do not resolve to names, so the identification rests on the counts producing the stated figures via the game's own +10% boost pair rather than on reading the item names.

It is applied after the Irradiant Pearl and bead armor multipliers and before Drizzle's flat +70, and it uses HasBuff rather than GetBuffCount, so it cannot stack.

name: Transcendence
pickupText: Convert all your health into shield. Increase maximum health.
description: Convert all but 1 health into regenerating shields. Gain 50% (+25% per stack) maximum health.

stacking.stat: Shield, as a % of your max health
stacking.formula: CharacterBody.RecalculateStats: `maxShield += maxHealth * (1.5f + (n - 1) * 0.25f); maxHealth = 1f`. The multiplier applies to the FINISHED health total, so it compounds with percentage health items rather than adding to them, and max health is then set to exactly 1. The game's own text calls this 'gain 50% maximum health' because a 150% shield in place of 100% health is a net +50% pool, but the pool is shield: it recharges by itself out of combat and healing cannot restore it.

stacking.stat: Max heal per second (% of health)
stacking.formula: restore rate = 0.1 / n of max health per second (HealthComponent). Reciprocal, so MORE stacks heal SLOWER: 10%/s at 1 stack, 5% at 2, 3.3% at 3, 2.5% at 4.

pickupText: Dramatically reduce Equipment cooldown... BUT it automatically activates.
description: Reduce Equipment cooldown by 50% (+15% per stack). Forces your Equipment to activate whenever it is off cooldown.

name: Purity
pickupText: Reduce your skill cooldowns by 2 seconds. You are unlucky.
description: All skill cooldowns are reduced by 2 (+1 per stack) seconds. All random effects are rolled +1 (+1 per stack) times for an unfavorable outcome.

stacking.formula: cooldown reduction = 2 + 1(n-1) seconds (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats). Linear.

-1 luck per stack (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats: luck -= Purity count). Luck L = (57 Leaf Clover stacks - Purity stacks). Util.CheckRoll rolls 1 + ceil(|L|) times and keeps the BEST result when L > 0, the WORST when L < 0. Effective chance = 1 - (1-p)^(1+L) for positive luck: a 10% proc becomes 19.0% at L=1 and 27.1% at L=2. With negative luck the worst roll is kept, so a 10% proc drops to ~1.0% at L=-1.

unlock.requirement: Escape the moon on Monsoon difficulty.

name: Visions of Heresy
pickupText: Replace your Primary Skill with 'Hungering Gaze'.
description: Fire a flurry of tracking shards that detonate after a delay for 120% base damage. Hold up to 12 charges (+12 per stack) that reload after 2 seconds (+2 per stack).

stacking.formula: LunarPrimaryReplacementSkill.GetMaxStock returns `n * baseMaxStock`, and the LunarPrimaryReplacement SkillDef asset has baseMaxStock = 12 — so 12 charges per stack.
GetRechargeInterval returns `n * baseRechargeInterval`, asset baseRechargeInterval = 2 — 2s per stack. Note this makes STACKING A DOWNSIDE for reload speed, as with every Heresy item.

name: Strides of Heresy
pickupText: Replace your Utility Skill with 'Shadowfade'.
description: Fade away, becoming intangible and gaining +30% movement speed. Heals 1.3% of your maximum health every 0.2s while active — about 19.5% (+19.5% per stack) in total, not the 25% the in-game text claims. Lasts 3 (+3 per stack) seconds.

stacking.formula: NOT a lump heal. GhostUtilitySkillState heals `healFractionPerTick` every `1 / healFrequency` seconds while the state runs; the asset gives 0.013 and 5, so 1.3% of max health every 0.2s. Over the 3n-second duration that is ~15n ticks = ~19.5% per stack. The in-game description's 25% is not attainable — there is exactly one EntityStateConfiguration for this state and its values are unambiguous. Ending the state early (it is interruptible) heals proportionally less.
GhostUtilitySkillState.OnEnter: `duration = baseDuration; duration *= n` with asset baseDuration = 3 — 3s per stack.

name: Hooks of Heresy
pickupText: Replace your Secondary Skill with 'Slicing Maelstrom'.
description: Charge a projectile dealing 875% damage per second to nearby enemies, exploding after 3 seconds for 700% damage and rooting enemies for 3 (+3 per stack) seconds. Recharges after 5 (+5 per stack) seconds.

stacking.formula: AddTimedBuff(Buffs.LunarSecondaryRoot, 3f * n) (GlobalEventManager). Linear.

LunarSecondaryReplacementSkill.GetRechargeInterval returns `n * baseRechargeInterval`, and the LunarSecondaryReplacement SkillDef asset has baseRechargeInterval = 5 — so 5s at one stack, +5s per stack. Code gives the shape, the asset gives the constant; neither alone settles it (PLAN 5.0.2).

unlock.requirement: Kill 15 boss monsters in a single run.

name: Essence of Heresy
pickupText: Replace your Special Skill with 'Ruin'.
description: Dealing damage adds a stack of Ruin for 10 seconds — a flat duration that does NOT increase with item stacks, despite the in-game text. Activating the skill detonates all Ruin stacks at unlimited range for 300% damage plus 120% per stack of Ruin. Recharges after 8 (+8 per stack) seconds.

stacking.formula: LunarDetonatorPassiveAttachment: `AddTimedBuff(LunarDetonationCharge, 10f)` — a FLAT 10 seconds, with no item count anywhere in that file. Checked at IL level rather than asserted: Buffs.LunarDetonationCharge is loaded at six sites in the whole assembly, and exactly ONE of them applies it — this line. The other five read GetBuffCount (Detonate, LunarDetonatorOrb), clear it (ClearTimedBuffs), or drive the visual effect. So the in-game text’s ‘(+10 per stack)’ is wrong: extra stacks do not lengthen Ruin, they only lengthen the cooldown. Application is also gated on the special skill having stock and rolls against `procCoefficient * 100`, so low-proc hits can fail to apply it.
LunarDetonatorSkill.GetRechargeInterval returns `n * baseRechargeInterval`, asset baseRechargeInterval = 8 — 8s per stack, so stacking lengthens the cooldown.

pickupText: Using a Shrine summons enemies nearby.

pickupText: Randomly create a Ward of Power. ALL characters deal bonus damage while in the Ward.
description: Creates a Ward of Power in a random nearby location, 16m (+50% per stack) in radius, that causes both enemies and allies inside to deal +50% damage.

name: Stone Flux Pauldron
pickupText: Double your health... BUT halve your speed.
description: Increase max health by 100% (+100% per stack). Reduce movement speed by 50% (+50% per stack).

moveSpeed x= 1/(1 + 2n) — the count is added to the speed divisor TWICE in RecalculateStats, confirmed at IL level (two separate `ldloc 46; add` into the divisor local; the local is stored only twice, a zero-init and the item count, so it is not a reused slot). Code-verified reduction: 66.7% at 1 stack, 80% at 2, 85.7% at 3. The in-game description says 50% (+50% per stack), which does not match the code.

descriptionNote: The movement-speed penalty is 66.7% at one stack, not 50%. The item adds to its divisor twice where Light Flux Pauldron adds once, which the two descriptions word identically.

attackSpeed /= (n + 1) (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats, applied ONCE - contrast Stone Flux Pauldron, which adds to its divisor twice). Reciprocal: 50% at 1, 66.7% at 2, 75% at 3, 80% at 4 - approaches but never reaches a full stop.

descriptionNote: The attack-speed penalty is not +50% per stack. It is reciprocal — 50% at one stack, 66.7% at two, 75% at three — approaching but never reaching 100%. The cooldown reduction beside it genuinely is compounding 50%, so the two halves of this sentence describe different curves.

TeamManager.GetLongstandingSolitudeItemCostScale = 1f + LongstandingSolitudesInParty() * 0.5f, applied by AdjustCostForLongstandingSolitude to every Money-type cost. +50% per stack. The separate gold-to-experience conversion caps at 8 effective stacks and converts at (0.12 + 0.0125(n-1)) of a level per small-chest-cost of gold earned.

name: Egocentrism

max bombs = 2 + n (LunarSunBehavior: return 2 + itemCount). Linear: 3 at 1 stack, 4 at 2, 5 at 3.

multiplier = 0.7 x 0.9^(n-1) (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats, TransferDebuffOnHit buff). Code-verified: -30% at 1 stack, then a further -10% per extra stack.
multiplier = 0.7 x 0.9^(n-1) (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats, TransferDebuffOnHit buff). Code-verified: -30% at 1 stack, then a further -10% per extra stack.
armor reduction = 35 + 15(n-1) (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats). Linear.

name: Eulogy Zero
pickupText: Items and equipment have a small chance to transform into a Lunar item instead.
description: Items have a 5% (+5% per stack) chance to become a Lunar item instead.

stacking.stat: Chance to become a Lunar item (%)
stacking.formula: rng.nextNormalizedFloat < 0.05f * n (RandomlyLunarUtils). Linear, +5% per stack. Uses the GLOBAL item count, so it is a party-wide effect.

name: Needletick
pickupText: Chance to collapse enemies on hit. Corrupts all Tri-Tip Daggers.
description: 10% (+10% per stack) chance to collapse an enemy for 400% base damage. Corrupts all Tri-Tip Daggers.

stacking.formula: LocalCheckRoll(procCoefficient * n * 10f) (GlobalEventManager). Linear, and it scales with the hit's proc coefficient. Undocumented: carrying the Void elite buff adds 10 to the effective stack count outright (`n += HasBuff(EliteVoid) ? 10 : 0`), which is why Void elites collapse so reliably.

name: Lost Seer's Lenses
pickupText: Gain a 0.5% chance to instantly kill a non-boss enemy. Corrupts all Lens-Maker's Glasses.
description: Your attacks have a 0.5% (+0.5% per stack) chance to instantly kill a non-Boss enemy. Corrupts all Lens-Maker's Glasses.

stacking.formula: LocalCheckRoll(n * 0.5f * damageInfo.procCoefficient) (HealthComponent), applying DamageType.VoidDeath. Linear at 0.5% per stack — but scaled by the hit's PROC COEFFICIENT, so low-proc attacks execute far less often than the flat figure suggests, and the whole branch is gated on `!body.isBoss`.

name: Safer Spaces
pickupText: Block the next source of damage. Corrupts all Tougher Times.
description: Blocks incoming damage once. Recharges after 15 seconds (-10% per stack). Corrupts all Tougher Times.

stacking.formula: recharge = 15 x 0.9^n seconds, where n is the FULL item count (HealthComponent: AddTimedBuff(BearVoidCooldown, 15f * Mathf.Pow(0.9f, itemCountEffective))). Code-verified: 13.5s at 1, 12.15s at 2, 10.94s at 3, 9.84s at 4. Note the exponent applies from the very first stack, so one Safer Spaces already recharges in 13.5s - the in-game description ("Recharges after 15 seconds (-10% per stack)") reads as though a single stack were the full 15.

descriptionNote: The recharge is 13.5s at one stack, not 15s. The -10% applies from the first stack, so it is 12.15s at two and 10.94s at three.

name: Weeping Fungus
pickupText: Heal while sprinting. Corrupts all Bustling Fungi.
description: Heals for 2% (+2% per stack) of your health every second while sprinting. Corrupts all Bustling Fungi.

stacking.stat: Heal per second while sprinting (% health)
stacking.formula: MushroomVoidBehavior: HealFraction(0.01f * stack) every 0.5s — so 1% twice a second, which is the stated 2% per second per stack. The tick rate matters for short sprints: stopping after 0.4s heals nothing at all.

name: Encrusted Key
pickupText: Gain access to an Encrusted Cache that contains a void item. Corrupts all Rusted Keys.
description: A hidden cache containing an item (60%/30%/10%) will appear in a random location on each stage. Opening the cache consumes this item. Corrupts all Rusted Keys.

stacking.stat: Void caches you can open (one spawns per stage)
stacking.formula: SceneDirector counts PLAYERS holding at least one key — `GetItemCountEffective(TreasureCacheVoid) > 0` increments once per player — and spawns that many void caches, exactly as Rusted Key does. Extra keys add no caches to a stage, and opening one consumes a key. NOT verified: this row previously claimed additional keys raise the cache's item rarity. That claim is not in the spawn path and was never sourced; it is removed rather than restated, since a formula field is read as provenance.

stacking.stat: Void cache drop split (% common / uncommon / legendary)
stacking.formula: The LockboxVoid prefab's `dropTable` pointer resolves in-bundle to dtVoidLockbox (ror2-dlc1-treasurecachevoid): voidTier1Weight = 5, voidTier2Weight = 5, voidTier3Weight = 2. That is 5/12, 5/12 and 2/12 — 41.7% void common, 41.7% void uncommon, 16.7% void legendary. The description's 60/30/10 is the 6/3/1 of dtVoidChest, a different table in ror2-base-common that this prefab does not point at.

descriptionNote: The game's own text is wrong here. It advertises 60%/30%/10%, but the void cache reads dtVoidLockbox, whose weights are 5:5:2 — an even split between void common and void uncommon at 41.7% each, and 16.7% legendary. The stated numbers match a different drop table (the generic void chest's 6:3:1) that this cache does not use. Stacking still does not spawn more caches: one spawns per player holding any Encrusted Key, and opening it consumes one key.

name: Plasma Shrimp
pickupText: While you have shield, fire missiles on every hit. Corrupts all AtG Missile Mk. 1s.
description: Gain a shield equal to 10% of your maximum health. While you have a shield, hitting an enemy fires a missile that deals 40% (+50% per stack) TOTAL damage. Corrupts all AtG Missile Mk. 1s.

stacking.formula: damageCoefficient = 0.4f * n via Util.OnHitProcDamage (GlobalEventManager) - a flat 40% per stack: 40%, 80%, 120%. Both our data and the in-game description said +50% per stack; the code is unambiguous. Gated on currently having shield. Pocket I.C.B.M.'s multiplier is applied on top.

descriptionNote: The missile deals +40% per stack, not +50%. The coefficient is a flat 0.4 x stacks: 40%, 80%, 120%.

name: Lysate Cell
pickupText: Add an extra charge of your Special skill. Corrupts all Fuel Cells.
description: Add +1 (+1 per stack) charge of your Special skill. Reduces Special skill cooldown by 33%. Corrupts all Fuel Cells.

stacking.formula: specialBonusStockSkill.SetBonusStockFromBody(n + extraSpecialFromSkill) (CharacterBody) - +1 charge per stack, carried with no numeric literal.

CharacterMaster.GetDeployableSameSlotLimit, DeployableSlot.EngiTurret: `(GetItemCountEffective(EquipmentMagazineVoid) <= 0) ? 2 : 3`. Holding ANY Lysate Cell raises Engineer's turret limit from 2 to 3; further stacks do nothing. Undocumented, and NOT shared with Fuel Cell, which it corrupts — Fuel Cell has no deployable-limit entry at all.

name: Polylute
pickupText: Chance to repeatedly strike a single enemy with lightning. Corrupts all Ukuleles.
description: 25% chance to fire lightning for 60% TOTAL damage up to 3 (+3 per stack) times. Corrupts all Ukuleles.

stacking.formula: damageCoefficient = 1f * n via Util.OnHitProcDamage (GlobalEventManager). Linear.

name: Voidsent Flame
pickupText: Full health enemies detonate on hit. Corrupts all Will-o'-the-wisps.
description: Upon hitting an enemy at or above 100% health, detonate them in a 12m (+2.4m per stack) radius burst for 260% (+156% per stack) base damage. Corrupts all Will-o'-the-wisps.

damageCoefficient = 2.6f * (1f + (n - 1) * 0.6f) (HealthComponent). Linear in n: 260% at one stack, +156% (= 260% x 0.6) per stack.

pickupText: Get a corrupted extra life. Consumed on use. Corrupts all Dio's Best Friends.

RespawnExtraLifeVoid does AddTimedBuff(Buffs.Immune, 3f), confirming the 3 seconds, and then walks ContagiousItemManager.transformationInfos calling TryForceReplacement on each — which is the 'all of your items that can be corrupted will be' clause, verified.

descriptionNote: The in-game text does not say what stacking does. Each copy is consumed separately, so N of them is N revives — and the corruption sweep runs on every revive, not only the first.

max Void allies = n (VoidMegaCrabItemBehavior: baseMaxAllies 1, maxAlliesPerStack 1). Linear.

description: Fire preon tendrils that zap enemies within 35m for 400% base damage per zap. On contact, detonate in a 20m explosion for 8000% base damage. Firing knocks you backwards. Cooldown: 140s.

descriptionNote: Both damage figures were previously stated at half their real value. The projectile is fired with `characterBody.damage * 2f` (EquipmentSlot), and both effects multiply that: the blast is `projectileDamage.damage * blastDamageCoefficient` with a coefficient of 40 (ProjectileExplosion), giving 8000%; each tendril zap is `projectileDamage.damage * damageCoefficient` with a coefficient of 2 (ProjectileProximityBeamController), giving 400%. The blast uses SweetSpot falloff, so 8000% is the centre value and it tapers toward the 20m edge. Zaps fire every 0.05s with a 0.33s per-target refresh and carry a proc coefficient of only 0.1.

pickupText: Toggle to fire. Costs gold per bullet.
description: Fire a continuous barrage that deals 100% damage per bullet. Costs $1 per bullet, increasing over time. Toggle-activated (no cooldown). Cooldown: 5s.

stacking.formula: EntityStates.GoldGat.GoldGatFire: damageCoefficient = 1 at procCoefficient = 1, force = 200, spread widening from minSpread 0 to maxSpread 3 as it winds up.

stacking.stat: Fire rate, start -> wound up (per second)
stacking.formula: `fireFrequency = Mathf.Lerp(minFireFrequency, maxFireFrequency, totalStopwatch / windUpDuration)` with 3, 15 and 10 — it opens at 3 bullets a second and reaches 15 after ten seconds of continuous fire, then stays there until you release. Letting go resets the wind-up.

stacking.stat: Gold per bullet at team level 1
stacking.formula: `(int)(baseMoneyCostPerBullet * (1f + (TeamManager.GetTeamLevel(team) - 1f) * 0.25f))` with baseMoneyCostPerBullet = 1. The cost rises with your TEAM LEVEL, not with time or with the difficulty coefficient — +25% of the base per level, truncated to an integer, so it is 1 gold per bullet until team level 5 and then climbs in whole steps.

unlock.requirement: Collect $30,480 total gold.

descriptionNote: Two things behind 'increasing over time'. The cost per bullet is keyed to team LEVEL (+25% of base per level, integer-truncated), so it stays at 1 gold until level 5. And the fire rate itself ramps: 3 bullets a second at the trigger pull, 15 after ten seconds of sustained fire, resetting when you let go.

name: Milky Chrysalis
pickupText: Gain temporary flight.
description: Sprout wings and fly for 15 seconds. Gain +20% movement speed for the duration. Cooldown: 60s.

stacking.formula: JetpackController prefab: duration = 15, acceleration = 200. Past the duration the controller stops providing flight and anti-gravity and clamps your downward velocity to -5, so the flight ends in a slow descent rather than a drop.
boostSpeedMultiplier = 3 on a boostCooldown of 0.5s: pressing jump WHILE MOVING sets velocity to moveVector x (moveSpeed x 3). It is a burst on a half-second timer, not a sustained speed increase.

RecalculateStats: `if (HasBuff(RoR2Content.Buffs.BugWings)) num98 += 0.2f` — additive into the same movement pool as Paul’s Goat Hoof, not a separate multiplier. So IF the buff is active the +20% is exact. What we could not establish is that anything applies it: Buffs.BugWings is loaded once in the whole assembly at IL level (that read), the equipment’s passiveBuffDef is null, JetpackController never calls AddBuff, and a reference scan over this item’s own bundle finds NOTHING pointing at the bdBugWings asset that ships there. Any application would have to be cross-bundle or outside RoR2.dll, which this tooling cannot follow — so the magnitude is verified and the trigger is not.

descriptionNote: The flight is a 15s window with a x3 dash on jump every 0.5s, and it ends with your fall speed clamped to -5 rather than dropping you. The +20% movement speed is real and is additive with your other movement items — `Buffs.BugWings` adds 0.2 to the same pool — though we have not found where the game applies that buff, only where it reads it.

name: Gnarled Woodsprite
pickupText: Heal over time. Activate to send to an ally.
description: Gain a Woodsprite follower that heals for 1.5% of your maximum health per second. Can be sent to an ally to heal them for 10% of their maximum health. Cooldown: 15s.

stacking.stat: Passive healing (% of max health per second)
stacking.formula: HealingFollower prefab: fractionHealthHealing = 0.015 on a healingInterval of 1. Note the C# field's own initialiser is 0.01 — the serialized value is what the game uses, and only it agrees with the description's 1.5%.

stacking.stat: Send-to-ally burst (% of their max health)
stacking.formula: Two paths, same figure: FirePassiveHealing calls `HealFraction(0.1f)` on the target directly, and the prefab carries fractionHealthBurst = 0.1. Here too the class initialiser (0.05) disagrees with both, and the prefab is right.

`passiveHealingFollower.AssignNewTarget(currentTarget.rootObject)` — using it does not summon anything, it retargets the follower you already have. With no ally targeted the handler falls back to `this.characterBody`, so pressing it while aiming at nothing bursts YOU for 10% and leaves the sprite where it was.

unlock.requirement: Fully upgrade a Shrine of the Woods.

descriptionNote: Aiming at nothing is not a wasted press: FirePassiveHealing falls back to your own body, so you get the 10% burst yourself. Sending the sprite away also moves its passive 1.5%/s to that ally — the two effects are the same sprite, not separate ones.

name: Primordial Cube
pickupText: Fire a black hole that draws enemies in.
description: Fire a black hole that draws enemies within 30m into its center. Lasts 10 seconds. Cooldown: 60s.

name: Radar Scanner
pickupText: Reveal all nearby interactables.
description: Reveal all interactables within 500m for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 45s.

stacking.formula: ChestScanner prefab, ChestRevealer component: radius = 500, revealDuration = 10, pulseInterval = 10, pulseTravelSpeed = 125. FireScanner spawns one instance at your core position.

The scanner object carries a DestroyOnTimer of 5s while pulseInterval is 10s, and nextPulse starts at negativeInfinity so the first pulse fires on the first FixedUpdate. It therefore pulses exactly ONCE and is destroyed long before a second — the reveal is a snapshot at cast time, not a rolling 10-second scan.

unlock.requirement: Collect 10 Monster or Environment Logs.

descriptionNote: The 10 seconds is how long the revealed markers stay up, not how long the scanner keeps looking. It sweeps once, at the moment you press the button, so anything that becomes revealable afterwards is missed.

name: Eccentric Vase
pickupText: Create a quantum tunnel between two locations.
description: Create a quantum tunnel of up to 1000m in length. Lasts 30 seconds. Cooldown: 45s.
