name: Blast Shower
pickupText: Cleanse all negative effects.
description: Cleanse all negative effects — debuffs, damage over time, and nearby projectiles. Cooldown: 20s.

stacking.formula: FireCleanse calls Util.CleanseBody(removeDebuffs: true, removeBuffs: FALSE, removeCooldownBuffs: true, removeDots: true, removeStun: true, removeNearbyProjectiles: true). Five categories go: debuffs, cooldown buffs, damage over time, stun, and nearby projectiles. Your own buffs are explicitly kept.

unlock.requirement: Die three times while burning.

descriptionNote: Two things the text leaves out. It also breaks stun and freeze, which is often the reason to press it. And it clears COOLDOWN buffs as well as debuffs — the flag is `removeCooldownBuffs: true` — so it is not purely beneficial. It does not touch your own buffs.

name: Volcanic Egg
pickupText: Transform into a speeding draconic fireball, dealing damage as you pass through enemies.
description: Turn into a draconic fireball for 5 seconds. Deal 500% damage on impact and detonate at the end for 800% damage. Cooldown: 30s.

stacking.formula: FireballVehicle prefab: overlapDamageCoefficient = 5 at overlapFireFrequency = 15. The hit rate looks like 15/s, but overlapResetFrequency = 0.00001 makes the reset period 100,000 seconds — the ignore list is never cleared, so each enemy takes the 500% exactly ONCE no matter how long you stay inside them.

blastDamageCoefficient = 8, blastRadius = 8, blastForce = 3000, and blastFalloffModel = None — so unlike most blasts in the game, the full 800% lands anywhere inside the 8m sphere rather than tapering toward the edge.

`age = Mathf.Max(0f, age - overlapVehicleDurationBonusPerHit)` on every successful overlap, with the field set to 5 and duration also 5. Each enemy you ram rewinds the ride timer by the FULL duration, so flying through a crowd extends the ride indefinitely. Nothing in the description hints at this.

descriptionNote: The 5 seconds is a floor, not a cap: every enemy you ram rewinds the timer by 5 seconds, so a dense crowd can keep you airborne far longer. The 500% is once per enemy — the ignore list never resets — and the 800% detonation has no distance falloff at all.

name: Jade Elephant
pickupText: Gain massive armor for 5 seconds.
description: Gain 500 armor for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 45s.

name: Sawmerang
pickupText: Throw a fan of buzzing saws that come back to you.
description: Throw three large saw blades that slice through enemies for 3x400% damage, plus 3x100% per second while bleeding. Can strike enemies again on the way back. Cooldown: 45s.

stacking.formula: FireSaw calls FireSingleSaw three times, at -15 degrees, 0 and +15 (`float num = 15f`), each firing Prefabs/Projectiles/Sawmerang.

stacking.stat: Damage per saw, once per enemy (%)
stacking.formula: ProjectileOverlapAttack on the Sawmerang prefab: damageCoefficient = 4 with resetInterval = -1. The reset is guarded by `if (resetInterval >= 0f)`, so a negative value disables it entirely and the ignore list is never cleared — 400% per saw per enemy, and the 60Hz fireFrequency only governs how often it looks for NEW targets.

A ProjectileDotZone on the Sawmerang prefab: damageCoefficient = 0.2 at fireFrequency = 30 with resetFrequency = 10 and lifetime = -1 (so it lasts as long as the saw). The reset cadence is what caps re-hits — Fire() skips anything still in the ignore list — so one enemy takes at most 10 x 20% = 200% per second per saw, at overlapProcCoefficient 0.2. NOT reconciled with the description's '3x100% per second': the arithmetic above is verified but we cannot confirm it is the figure that clause refers to, and 200 vs 100 is too large a gap to publish as a correction on that basis.

The Sawmerang prefab's ProjectileDamage carries `damageType = { damageType: 0, damageTypeExtended: 0, damageSource: 0 }` — no flags at all, so the saw applies NO bleed and nothing that Tri-Tip Dagger's BleedOnHit path would recognise. The description's 'while bleeding' is flavour for the sustained contact damage above, not a bleed proc.

descriptionNote: "Can strike enemies again on the way back" is not what the code does. The saw's overlap attack has resetInterval = -1, which disables the reset, and BoomerangProjectile never calls ResetOverlapAttack — so each saw hits a given enemy once, outbound or returning, whichever happens first. The game does implement return-pass re-hits, but for Chef's Cleaver: CleaverProjectile calls ResetOverlapAttack explicitly and its prefab carries a recallDamageCoefficient. Sawmerang has neither. It also applies no bleed — its damageType is empty — so "while bleeding" names no mechanic you can build around.

name: Recycler
pickupText: Transform an Item or Equipment into a different one. Can only recycle once.
description: Transform an item or equipment into a different one of the same rarity tier. Each drop can only be recycled once. Cooldown: 45s.

stacking.formula: FireRecycle sets NetworkRecycled = true and refuses any pickup where Recycled is already set, so a given drop can be recycled exactly once. The replacement is drawn with Run.instance.treasureRng.NextElementUniform from PickupTransmutationManager.GetAvailableGroupFromPickupIndex, minus the item you started with — a uniform roll over the rest of its transmutation GROUP, which is not quite the same set as its rarity tier.

unlock.requirement: Destroy 20 flying rocks in Sky Meadow.

descriptionNote: If the pickup's transmutation group has no other member, FireRecycle returns false — and a handler that returns false never reaches OnEquipmentExecuted, so the use is refused and the cooldown is NOT spent. Aiming at something unrecyclable costs you nothing.

name: Super Massive Leech
pickupText: Heal for a percentage of the damage you deal for 8 seconds.
description: Gain Life Steal, healing for 20% of all direct damage dealt, for 8 seconds. Cooldown: 60s.

name: Gorag's Opus
pickupText: You and all your allies enter a frenzy.
description: You and all your allies enter a frenzy for 7 seconds, gaining +50% movement speed and +100% attack speed. Cooldown: 45s.

name: Forgive Me Please
pickupText: Throw a cursed doll that repeatedly triggers your 'On Kill' effects.
description: Throw a cursed doll that triggers your On-Kill effects every 1 second for 8 seconds. Cooldown: 45s.

stacking.formula: DeathProjectile prefab: baseDuration = 8, ticking once per second (`fixedAge >= 1f`, then `duration -= 1f`). Each tick builds a DamageReport whose victim is the doll's own HealthComponent and hands it to GlobalEventManager.OnCharacterDeath — which is why it fires on-kill effects without anything actually dying.

unlock.requirement: Die 20 times.

descriptionNote: The eight ticks only run while the doll is STUCK to something: the countdown is inside `if (projectileStickOnImpactController.stuck)`, so a throw that lands on nothing sticks to nothing and never ticks.

name: Fuel Array
pickupText: Looks like it could power something. EXTREMELY unstable...
description: A single-use objective item used to power REX in the Abyssal Depths. Detonates for 300% of your maximum health if you fall below 50% health. Cannot be scrapped or selected from Command.

stacking.formula: EntityStates.QuestVolatileBattery.Monitor: healthFractionDetonationThreshold = 0.5f, tested against HealthComponent.combinedHealthFraction — health PLUS shield and barrier, not health alone — and only on the crossing (`frac <= 0.5f && 0.5f < previousFrac`), so it arms once as you fall past half, not repeatedly while you stay there.
CountDown.duration = 3 (EntityStateConfiguration). The countdown is not cancellable by healing back above the threshold: CountDown only checks fixedAge.

CountDown.explosionRadius = 30 (EntityStateConfiguration), fired as a BlastAttack with falloffModel = None — so every target inside 30m takes the FULL damage, with no drop-off by distance. procCoefficient is 0, so it triggers no on-hit items.

stacking.stat: Damage (% of your full combined health)
stacking.formula: CountDown.Detonate: baseDamage = attachedHealthComponent.fullCombinedHealth * 3f. Note it is your COMBINED pool (health + shield + barrier), matching the arming check, and the equipment is consumed (SetEquipmentIndex(None)) on detonation.

descriptionNote: Fuel Array is not an activated equipment — it has no fire handler at all, so it cannot be used on demand and has no cooldown. It arms itself the moment your combined health (including shield and barrier) crosses below half, then detonates 3 seconds later regardless of whether you heal back up.

name: Molotov (6-Pack)
pickupText: Throw 6 flaming molotovs that ignite enemies upon shattering.
description: Throw 6 molotov cocktails that ignite enemies for 500% base damage. Each leaves a burning area dealing 200% damage per second. Cooldown: 45s.

stacking.formula: MolotovClusterProjectile: childrenCount = 6, fireChildren = true, scattered over rangePitchDegrees 80 / rangeRollDegrees 360, each child a MolotovSingleProjectile at childrenDamageCoefficient = 1 (full inherited damage).
blastDamageCoefficient = 2.5 in a blastRadius of 7 on each bomblet.

The bomblet applies dotIndex 1 (Burn) with calculateTotalDamage = true and totalDamageMultiplier = 2.5, and ProjectileExplosion resolves that as `dotInfo.totalDamage = characterBody.damage * totalDamageMultiplier` — a TOTAL of 250%, not a rate. Impact plus burn is where the description's 500% comes from.

stacking.stat: Fire puddle damage (% per second, for 7s)
stacking.formula: MolotovProjectileDotZone: damageCoefficient = 1 at fireFrequency = 1, lifetime = 7, overlapProcCoefficient = 0.5, resetFrequency = 3 (so the ignore list clears between fires and everyone inside is hit each tick). ProjectileDotZone computes `attack.damage = damageCoefficient * projectileDamage.damage`, and the puddle's damage is base damage: both hops of the chain use childrenDamageCoefficient = 1, and ProjectileExplosion passes children `projectileDamage.damage * childrenDamageCoefficient`. Every pointer in that chain resolves inside the item's own bundle, so nothing here is inferred — the puddle is 100% per second, against the 200% the description states.

descriptionNote: Two corrections in one item. The '500% base damage' is right but is a sum: 250% impact plus a 250% burn TOTAL (ProjectileExplosion resolves calculateTotalDamage as a total, not a rate). The burning area is NOT 200% per second — it is 100%, at proc coefficient 0.5, for 7 seconds. Both hops from the thrown cluster to the puddle carry a damage coefficient of 1, so no step doubles it; the stated figure is twice what the game does.

name: Executive Card
pickupText: Gain 10% cash back on all purchases. Multishops remain open.
description: Whenever you make a gold purchase, get 10% of the spent gold back. Multishop terminals stay open after a purchase. Cooldown: 0.1s.

stacking.formula: MultiShopCardUtils: `refundPercentage = 0.1f`, paid as a GoldOrb of `(uint)(0.1f * moneyCost)` flying from the thing you bought to you. Integer cast, so purchases under 10 gold refund nothing.

OnPurchase requires `equipmentSlot.stock > 0` and then calls OnEquipmentExecuted(), so the 0.1s cooldown is genuinely consumed once per qualifying purchase. Pressing the equipment key does nothing at all — there is no EquipmentSlot handler for MultiShopCard.

SetCloseOnTerminalPurchase(..., doCloseMultiShop: false) is applied to both ShopTerminalBehavior and DroneVendorTerminalBehavior — so drone vendors stay open too, which the description does not mention.

descriptionNote: It is not activated: pressing the key does nothing, and the 0.1s cooldown is spent by the purchase itself. A non-gold purchase (lunar coin, item cost) still keeps the multishop open and still consumes the charge, but refunds nothing — the gold orb only fires when the cost was money.

name: Goobo Jr.
pickupText: Create a clone of you for 30 seconds.
description: Spawn a gummy clone with 300% damage and 300% health, using your skill loadout. Expires in 30 seconds. Up to 3 clones can exist at once. Cooldown: 100s.

name: Remote Caffeinator
pickupText: Request a healing soda machine.
description: Request an Eclipse Zero Vending Machine from the UES Safe Travels, delivered in 5 seconds for 2000% damage. Heals up to 3 targets for 25% of their maximum health. Cooldown: 60s.

stacking.formula: VendingMachineProjectile: blastDamageCoefficient = 20 in a blastRadius of 16, at blastProcCoefficient 1.

stacking.stat: Healing per target (% of their max health)
stacking.formula: The VendingMachine component's healFraction = 0.25, with numBonusOrbs = 2 — the primary target plus two bonus orbs is the description's 'up to 3 targets'.
vendingRadius = 50 on the machine, which also carries maxPurchases = 12.

FireVendingMachine ends with `subcooldownTimer = 0.5f`, and both activation paths refuse to fire while it is above zero. Immaterial next to the 60s cooldown, but it is where that constant actually belongs.

The machine is placed by a downward CharacterRaycast of 1000m against LayerIndex.world. With no world geometry below you the handler returns false, so the use is refused and the cooldown is not spent.

descriptionNote: The description gives the payload but not the delivery. The machine is placed by a 1000m downward raycast, so with no ground beneath you the use is refused and the 60s cooldown is NOT spent. Once landed it serves within 50m and sells at most 12 times. The 25% heal reaches three targets because the machine fires one primary heal plus numBonusOrbs = 2.

name: Seed of Life
pickupText: Revives the user when killed or dead allies on activation. Consumed on use.
description: Revive dead friendly Survivors on activation. Dying while holding it returns only you to life. Reviving grants 3s of invulnerability and consumes the equipment.

unlock.requirement: Journey to the Prime Meridian and defeat the False Son.

name: Deus Ex Machina
pickupText: Counter any damage. Successful counters bless your next attack, ensuring your on-hit effects ALWAYS activate.
description: Enter a countering stance for 0.5s that parries any and all damage. A successful parry nullifies the damage, reduces the active equipment's cooldown by 75% of its full cooldown, and grants Blessing (the SureProc buff) — your next attack always activates its on-hit effects. Cooldown: 60s.

name: Trophy Hunter's Tricorn
pickupText: Execute a large monster and claim its trophy. Consumed on use.
description: Execute any enemy capable of spawning a unique reward and it will drop that item. Consumed on use.

name: Effigy of Grief
pickupText: Drop a permanent effigy that cripples ALL characters inside. Can place up to 5.
description: Drop a permanent effigy. ALL characters within 15m are slowed by 50% and have their armor reduced by 20. Can place up to 5. Cooldown: 15s.

name: Glowing Meteorite
pickupText: Rain meteors from the sky, hurting both enemies and allies.
description: Rain meteors from the sky, damaging ALL characters for 600% damage per blast. Lasts 20 seconds. Cooldown: 140s.

stacking.formula: MeteorStorm prefab: blastDamageCoefficient = 6, blastRadius = 8, blastForce = 4000, impactDelay = 2. MeteorStormController fires it as a BlastAttack with falloffModel = Linear and procCoefficient = 1 — so 600% is the figure at the centre and it drops off toward the edge of the 8m sphere.

waveCount = 20, waveMinInterval = 0.5, waveMaxInterval = 1.5. Twenty waves at a random 0.5-1.5s apart is roughly 10-30 seconds of storm, averaging about 20 — the '20' in the description is a count of waves, not a duration in seconds.

unlock.requirement: Carry 5 Lunar items in a single run.

descriptionNote: 'Lasts 20 seconds' is really 20 WAVES, spaced a random 0.5-1.5s apart, so the storm runs anywhere from about 10 to about 30 seconds. The 'ALL characters' part is exact and worth taking literally: the blast is fired with teamIndex = None and AttackerFiltering.AlwaysHit, so it hits you and your allies at full strength.

name: Helfire Tincture
pickupText: Ignite everything nearby... including you and allies.
description: Ignite ALL characters within 15m for 12s, dealing 5% of your maximum health per second as burning damage. The burn is 0.5x on yourself, 0.25x on allies, and 24x on enemies. Cooldown: 45s.

unlock.requirement: Kill 15 enemies simultaneously.

name: Spinel Tonic
pickupText: Gain a massive boost to ALL stats. Chance to gain an affliction that reduces ALL stats.
description: Gain a 20-second buff: +100% damage, +70% attack speed, +20 armor, +50% max health, +50% max shield, +300% regen, +30% movement speed. On expiration, a 20% chance to gain a Tonic Affliction. Each Affliction stack multiplies attack speed, movement speed, damage, and regeneration by 0.95 — compounding, not -5% per stack — and adds a 10% curse, which lowers your maximum health. The Affliction is suspended entirely while a Tonic buff is active. Cooldown: 60s.

unlock.requirement: Discover and enter three unique portals.

name: Ifrit's Distinction
pickupText: Become an aspect of fire.
description: Gain Blazing Elite powers: your attacks apply a burn for 50% TOTAL damage on hit, and a fire trail follows burned enemies. Passive (no cooldown).

name: Silence Between Two Strikes
pickupText: Become an aspect of lightning.
description: Gain the power of an Overloading Elite: your attacks plant a delayed lightning stake dealing 50% TOTAL damage, and half of your maximum health is converted into shield. Passive (no cooldown).

name: Her Biting Embrace
pickupText: Become an aspect of ice.
description: Gain the power of a Glacial Elite: apply an 80% slow for 1.5s on hit — the duration is multiplied by the hit's proc coefficient, so weak hits slow for less — and leave a delayed ice explosion on death with a radius of 12m plus your body radius. Passive (no cooldown).

name: Spectral Circlet
pickupText: Become an aspect of incorporeality.
description: Gain the power of a Celestine Elite: your attacks apply an 80% slow for 3s on hit — twice the duration a Glacial Elite applies, and scaled by the hit's proc coefficient — and a ward with a 30m radius (plus your body radius) cloaks nearby allies. Passive (no cooldown).

name: His Spiteful Boon
pickupText: Become an aspect of spite.
description: Gain the power of a Twisted Elite: tether to up to 5 allies within 35m, granting them 300 armor. If tethered allies are hit 10 times, fire a lunar spike ball that homes onto an enemy for 1250% damage and inflicts Lunar Ruin twice, each stack lasting 420s. Tethering disables for 10s after launching. Passive.

name: N'kuhana's Retort
pickupText: Become an aspect of corruption.
description: Gain the power of a Malachite Elite: inflict a healing-disabled debuff for 8s on enemies, periodically release spiked balls that explode and leave spike pits, and spawn a Malachite Urchin on death. Passive.

stacking.formula: CharacterBody.UpdateAffixPoison fires when poisonballTimer >= 6f, then resets it.

stacking.stat: Orbs per volley (on a human-sized body)
stacking.formula: `int num = 3 + (int)radius` — the count scales with your BODY's collision radius, so a larger survivor throws more orbs from the same aspect. They are spread evenly at 360/num degrees, tilted 0.4363 rad (25 degrees) up from vertical toward your facing.
Fired with `damage * 1f` via PoisonOrbProjectile.
GlobalEventManager on hit: `AddTimedBuff(Buffs.HealingDisabled, 8f * damageInfo.procCoefficient)`. The 8 seconds is the figure at proc coefficient 1 — a half-proc hit applies four seconds, not eight.

descriptionNote: Two things the text does not say: the number of spiked balls per volley scales with your character's collision radius (3 + radius, so bigger survivors get more), and the 8-second healing-disable is multiplied by the proc coefficient of the hit that applied it.

name: His Reassurance
pickupText: Become an aspect of earth.
description: Gain the power of a Mending Elite: continuously heal nearby allies, and spawn a Healing Core on death that detonates to heal all nearby allies. Passive.

stacking.formula: AffixEarthBodyAttachment carries a HealNearbyController with maxTargets = 1. The sphere search stops at the first eligible ally, so 'heal nearby allies' heals exactly ONE per tick — not everyone in range. Targets must be below full health, and anything already carrying EliteEarth is skipped, so two Mending holders never heal each other.

stacking.stat: Healing (% of your damage per second)
stacking.formula: damagePerSecondCoefficient = 1.2 at tickRate = 3: each tick heals `1.2 x attachedBody.damage / 3`, i.e. 40% of your damage three times a second. It scales with YOUR damage stat, not with the ally's health.
radius = 30 on the same component, plus the attached body's own radius (`sphereSearch.radius = radius + attachedBody.radius`).
EntityStates.AffixEarthHealer.Heal: healCoefficient = 4 in radius = 12, after a Chargeup of 3s and a DeathState of 0.5s.

descriptionNote: 'Continuously heal nearby allies' heals one ally at a time — maxTargets is 1. With a full team the aura round-robins rather than topping everyone up at once.

name: Shared Design
pickupText: Become an aspect of perfection.
description: Gain the power of a Perfected Elite: attacks inflict Cripple for 3s, you fire 4 bombs every 10 seconds for 30% damage each while in combat, and you gain +30% movement speed. ALL of your health becomes a regenerating shield worth 125% of your maximum health, leaving you at 1 HP — the same code path as Transcendence, not a partial conversion. Passive.

name: Of One Mind
pickupText: Become an aspect of the Collective.
description: Gain the power of a Collective Elite: a 30m dome blocks projectiles and reduces ally and self skill cooldowns by 25%. On death, explode for 100% damage and disable enemy items for 2.5s. The dome disables for 8s when hit by a skill attack. Passive.

stacking.formula: TargetNearbyHealthComponents on AffixCollectiveBodyAttachment: radius = 30, maxTargets = 50, tickRate = 0.5 — the membership list is rebuilt every two seconds, not continuously, and seated characters are excluded (IgnoreSeatedCharacters).

RecalculateStats: `if (num75 > 0) num113 *= 0.75f`, where num75 is `HasBuff(EliteCollective) ? 1 : GetBuffCount(CollectiveShareBuff)` — the holder gets it from the aspect, allies from the shared buff. It is a presence check, not a count, so standing in two domes gives no extra reduction.

stacking.stat: Dome downtime after a skill hit (s)
stacking.formula: ColliderDisableIfHitDuration is serialized as 8 on the AffixCollectiveBodyAttachment prefab. Worth noting the C# field's own initialiser is 10f — reading the class rather than the prefab would have produced a 10 that contradicts the game's text. The dome then regrows at ColliderGrowSpeed 3 after shrinking at 5.

CollectiveDeathProjectile: blastDamageCoefficient = 1 in a blastRadius of 11. Deaths inside a collective are chained with delayBetweenDeaths = 0.8f, so members fall in sequence rather than all at once.

descriptionNote: The 25% cooldown cut is a presence check rather than a count — two overlapping domes are worth no more than one. Membership is also re-scanned only twice a second (tickRate 0.5), so an ally who steps in is not covered instantly.

name: Aurelionite's Blessing
pickupText: Become an aspect of radiance.
description: Gain the power of a Gilded Elite: on hit, knock 8 gold out of enemies as collectible nuggets (scaling over time), and gain a rechargeable grounded spike attack for 15% (outer) / 150% (inner) damage. Cooldown: 25s.

stacking.formula: Both projectiles are fired with `attackerBody.damage * aurelioniteAttackDamageCoeff` where that constant is 1.5f, and each prefab then applies its own blastDamageCoefficient: inner 1.0 -> 150%, outer 0.1 -> 15%. Reading either half alone gives the wrong answer, which is why the prefab values (0.1 and 1.0) look nothing like the description's 15% and 150%.

delayBeforeFiringWarning = 1f then delayBeforeFiringAttack = 2f, and the strike leads a moving target by predictIntoTheFutureByHowManySeconds = 1.5f. Note the 10-13s timer in this behaviour (rawCooldownDuration 10 + randomCooldownMaximum 3) is NOT yours: the autonomous loop is gated on `useRandomTargetingForNearbyEnemy || baseAI != null`, and holding the equipment sets that flag false while a player has no BaseAI — so for a holder the strike runs on the equipment's own 25s cooldown and you aim it.

stealGoldInAdjustedIncrementsOf = 8 with procChanceOfPlayerAttackSpawningGold = 100f — every hit knocks gold loose, not a chance on hit. The amount taken from the victim is percentageOfGoldCopiedFromEnemy = 0.8 and the payout runs through goldCoefficient = 75.
hitCircleRadius = 7.5f, with the outer ring's blastRadius 3 and the centre's 3.5.

name: Hearty Stew
pickupText: Increases health regeneration and converts it into damage at full health. A single sip leaves you feeling warm and fuzzy inside.
description: Increases base health regeneration by +2.5 hp/s (+2.5 hp/s per stack). At full health, your ENTIRE health regeneration — from every source, not just this item — is added to your base damage.

stacking.formula: regen += 2.5f * n x levelScale (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats). Linear.

name: Quick Fix
pickupText: Increases bonus health and regen gains. Does not benefit from leveling up bonuses. Full of minerals.
description: Increases bonus health and regeneration gains by 50% (+15% per stack). Does not affect bonuses from leveling up.

stacking.formula: The item raises the level-scaling multiplier itself: `levelScale += 0.5f + 0.15f * (n - 1)` (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats), so +50% at one stack and +15% per stack thereafter. Because it scales that shared multiplier, it amplifies every per-level health and regen source at once — which is why the description says it does not affect bonuses from leveling up: those are applied elsewhere.

name: Sautéed Worms
pickupText: Chance on hit to summon a spectral wyrm that seeks out and damages enemies. Tastes like glass frogs and starseed.
description: On hit, 10% chance to summon a spectral wyrm that seeks out and damages and ignites enemies for 500% (+500% per stack) TOTAL damage per second for 10 seconds.

stacking.formula: WyrmOnHitBehavior: baseProcChance 10f multiplied by the hit's proc coefficient, firing a wyrm with `damage = damageInfo.damage * (5f * stack)` and projectileLifetime 10f. Two limits the description omits: a 1s internal cooldown (baseCooldown) and a cap of 8 simultaneous wyrms (DeployableSlot.WyrmOnHit).

name: Seared Steak
pickupText: Gain 50 max health plus a percentage of your max health. Cooked to perfection.
description: Increases maximum health by 50 (+50 per stack), plus an additional 5% (+5% per stack) of your max health.

stacking.formula: maxHealth += n * (50f x levelScale) (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats). Linear.
The percentage term is a separate addition, `healthMultiplier += n * (0.05f x levelScale)`, so the flat 50 and the 5% do not compound — they are summed independently like Titanic Knurl's two effects.

name: Ultimate Meal
pickupText: At full health, you become lucky. The pinnacle of culinary arts.
description: At full health, all random effects are rolled +2 (+2 per stack) extra times for a better outcome.

stacking.formula: master.luck += 2f + (n - 1) * m, where m is 1 at one stack and 2 beyond (CharacterBody.RecalculateStats) — so +2 luck at one stack and +2 per stack after. Gated entirely on the UltimateMealBoost buff (the at-full-health condition), and it feeds the same `luck` value as 57 Leaf Clover (+1 each) and Purity (-1 each), so the three combine.
